entries.name: Apollo Server
entries.use_for: Serve a spec-compliant GraphQL API from Node.js.
entries.why: The most widely used JavaScript GraphQL server, with federation support.

entries.name: Appwrite
entries.use_for: Self-hostable backend-as-a-service with auth, databases, storage, functions and messaging for web and mobile apps.
entries.why: Mature open-source Firebase alternative with SDKs for most platforms and an active community.

entries.name: axum
entries.use_for: Ergonomic, modular Rust web framework built on Tokio, Tower and Hyper
entries.why: The default choice for Rust web backends, maintained by the Tokio team

entries.name: Django Ninja
entries.use_for: Build fast, typed REST APIs on top of Django using Python type hints.
entries.why: FastAPI-style DX inside Django with automatic OpenAPI; actively maintained.

entries.name: Django REST framework
entries.use_for: Build REST APIs on Django with serializers, auth and a browsable API
entries.why: The standard Django API toolkit; 1,500+ contributors.

entries.name: Elysia
entries.use_for: Ergonomic, end-to-end type-safe web framework optimised for Bun
entries.why: Leading Bun-first framework with very high throughput and Eden end-to-end type inference

entries.name: Express
entries.use_for: Minimal, unopinionated web framework for Node.js
entries.why: The most used Node.js server framework with the largest middleware ecosystem; Express 5 is actively maintained

entries.name: FastAPI
entries.use_for: Build typed Python APIs with automatic validation and OpenAPI docs.
entries.why: The most popular modern Python API framework, built on Starlette and Pydantic.

entries.name: Fastify
entries.use_for: Fast, low-overhead Node.js web framework with schema-based validation and plugins
entries.why: OpenJS Foundation project; one of the fastest Node frameworks, with first-class TypeScript and a rich plugin system

entries.name: Fiber
entries.use_for: Build high-performance HTTP APIs in Go with an Express-like API.
entries.why: One of the most popular Go web frameworks, built on fasthttp.

entries.name: Flask
entries.use_for: Lightweight Python web framework for APIs and web apps
entries.why: Battle-tested Python microframework with a huge extension ecosystem

entries.name: Frappe Framework
entries.use_for: Build metadata-driven business apps with auto-generated REST APIs and admin UI
entries.why: Powers ERPNext; batteries-included Python/JS framework with 1,000+ contributors.

entries.name: Gin
entries.use_for: Fast HTTP web framework for Go with routing, middleware and binding
entries.why: The most popular Go web framework; simple API and large middleware ecosystem

entries.name: go-zero
entries.use_for: Build Go microservices with built-in RPC, resilience features and code generation.
entries.why: Batteries-included cloud-native microservice framework with goctl codegen; 33k stars.

entries.name: GoFr
entries.use_for: Build Go microservices with built-in DB, pub/sub and tracing support
entries.why: Opinionated Go framework with observability, migrations and health checks out of the box.

entries.name: gqlgen
entries.use_for: Generate a type-safe GraphQL server in Go from a schema.
entries.why: The standard schema-first GraphQL library for Go.

entries.name: Grape
entries.use_for: Build REST-like APIs in Ruby, standalone or mounted in Rails
entries.why: Long-standing Rack API DSL with versioning, validation and entity presenters.

entries.name: GraphQL Yoga
entries.use_for: Run a fully featured GraphQL server on Node, Bun, Deno or edge runtimes.
entries.why: Lightweight, plugin-based GraphQL server from The Guild with easy setup.

entries.name: Hasura GraphQL Engine
entries.use_for: Instant, realtime GraphQL and REST APIs on top of Postgres and other databases, with permissions built in.
entries.why: Removes most API boilerplate; widely used in production for GraphQL over existing databases.

entries.name: Hono
entries.use_for: Build fast APIs that run on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node and other runtimes.
entries.why: Tiny, Web-Standards-based framework with first-class TypeScript and multi-runtime support.

entries.name: Hot Chocolate
entries.use_for: Build GraphQL servers and gateways in .NET.
entries.why: The leading GraphQL platform for .NET, including server, client and gateway.

entries.name: Huma
entries.use_for: Build Go REST APIs with automatic OpenAPI 3.1 docs and request validation.
entries.why: Router-agnostic, schema-first Go API framework with strong typing.

entries.name: Javalin
entries.use_for: Build simple REST APIs and web apps in Java or Kotlin.
entries.why: Lightweight, unopinionated JVM web framework with a small API surface.

entries.name: NestJS
entries.use_for: Build structured, modular Node.js backends with dependency injection and decorators.
entries.why: The most adopted opinionated Node.js framework for larger TypeScript services.

entries.name: Parse Server
entries.use_for: Self-host a backend-as-a-service with data, auth, files and push on Node.js
entries.why: Mature open BaaS with REST/GraphQL APIs and SDKs for every platform.

entries.name: PocketBase
entries.use_for: Open-source backend in one file: embedded SQLite database, auth, file storage, realtime subscriptions and an admin UI.
entries.why: Simplest way to get a full backend for a side project or MVP; single binary, also usable as a Go framework.

entries.name: Spring Boot
entries.use_for: Production-ready Java/Kotlin applications and REST services with auto-configuration
entries.why: The dominant JVM backend framework, with integrations for nearly every database, queue and cloud

entries.name: tRPC
entries.use_for: End-to-end typesafe APIs in TypeScript without schemas or code generation
entries.why: Standard way to share types between a TS backend and frontend; adapters for Next.js, Fastify, Express and more
